Set up. A cron job (ffd889368b2f) will post a "Pod end of day" note in #strategic-pod on weekdays at 17:30 Chicago time, listing that day's new messages in the channel.

Three things to know:
- The Hermes gateway isn't running, so the job won't fire until it's started (`hermes gateway start`).
- I scheduled it as 22:30 UTC, which is 17:30 CDT. The scheduler's timezone isn't confirmed, and the job will be an hour late after daylight saving ends on 1 Nov. Someone should check it once the gateway is up.
- Today's 17:30 run is not covered.

I also posted a setup note in #strategic-pod replying to June. It is wordier than it needed to be.
